relations.rationale: General comparison of locomotives doesn't specify ranking results in the scratch-building competition.
Comparing locomotives is unrelated to the specific ranking order between Nell and Finn.
Comparing locomotives throughout the afternoon doesn't imply anything about Finn's placement with freight wagons.
Comparing locomotives has no bearing on whether Finn and Nell are in the same class.
Members comparing locomotives is unrelated to members lining up for sandwiches.
Comparing locomotives throughout the afternoon is consistent with but doesn't specifically indicate visitors arriving later.

If Nell ranked third, this directly supports that she ranked just behind whoever was second, consistent with being behind Finn.
Nell ranking third is consistent with Finn placing second, supporting the idea that Finn ranked above Nell.
If Nell ranked just behind Finn, this supports that Finn placed second (one rank above third-place Nell).
